name: query_knowledge_base
description: Retrieve grounded answers for pricing, policy, coverage, exclusions, and objection-handling questions. Must be called before answering any factual question about CareShield's plans — never answer from memory.

query.description: The caller's question, in natural language, e.g. 'does the gold plan cover pre-existing conditions'

name: create_lead
description: Business action: log a qualified lead, a callback request, or an escalation into the mock CRM once qualification data has been collected or the caller asks for a human.

notes.description: Free-text context, e.g. reason for escalation or which field was left pending
